text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen... The dream stage, 
predicted to be a fierce and chaotic 
free-for-all, has finally arrived.

The grand stage where the strongest active 
Umamusume gather. To El Condor Pasa, this 
race was her "runway of dreams" to take 
flight into the world.

As the crowd's excitement reached its 
peak, the three conveyed to one another 
that they had no intention of losing.

In order to defeat both of them and take 
flight into the world... El Condor Pasa 
stepped onto the stage of the dream match.
